title: Generic interface for the exact second trace equality
statement: For a commutative condensed coefficient Lambda, a scheme Y, Tate family L, normalized Diagram d, second shifted-line comparison e, a derived object M on the projective line over Y, an arrow f from twist(q*Rq_*M) to M, and a forward-projection-shaped arrow J, define SecondTraceEquation to be the proposition structure with one field: for every pair of invertibility proofs hb,hp, J followed by the class-free unitTail and f equals identity_M tensor the canonically transported second trace, followed by the right unitor. This is exactly the literal trace equality, without extra data or assumptions. The proved helper assemble_second_unit composes any insertion equation with this trace field to obtain the literal unit contraction; it introduces no geometric hypothesis or proof hole.

proof.text: Define a proposition structure whose sole field is the exact trace-tail equality for every pair of proofs of invertibility of its fixed exchange and projection arrows. Retain the specified canonical second direct-image comparison and coefficient unitor. Use the object M and post-tail arrow f as explicit parameters, so the interface does not expand a selected coefficient, its site or a composite functor. This provides an interface only and makes no choice of map data.

Given the insertion factorization and a SecondTraceEquation, factor the literal ambient unit with unitComponent_factor, substitute those two equations, combine the two tensor whiskerings, and cancel the canonical second direct-image comparison with its inverse. This proves assemble_second_unit in the generic coefficient interface without unfolding a selected coefficient or its site.
